candidates.label: WF40 recovery
candidates.detail: recovery ship candidate after the detour cycle (2026-10-15, rounds 6-7): fresh H=40 widen-freeze from S4, ~900 gens of detour pursuit (blockade unlearned at every geometry, blocks partial — both dropped from the chip band, WF_CHIP_KINDS = the clean 13-kind set; dialog rows stay), selection-blind drift (sigma-boost 2.25x + a blind T2) recovered from the wf-of2a-g200 base via 400 full-band re-polish gens under the T2 JSON watchdog — holdout mean 92.6% over the 13 chip kinds vs S4 90.9% on the SAME harder loosened courses: gates/grid/bay/corridor/field 100%, crux 98%, slalom 97%, dense 95%, rslalom 92%, maze 91%, crowd 88%, free 72%, deadend 71% (the known weakness: chain C, the two-bay double-reversal, offcourse at 111-136 m — all 7 deadend failures are that chain; blocks partial 8%, 17->12->8->8 through the recovery). A guarded deadend+free focus chunk was tried before ship and REJECTED on the band (deadend fixed 88% > S4 83, free 81, but the unexercised kinds drifted to a 63.9% mean — the focus-mode signature); the deadend-fix genome is preserved at wf-of2r-de-g523.candidate.json for a future deadend-focus + full-band-release pump. The detour kinds stay parked for the fitness-shaping revisit.
